notes.title: Finally, an update!
notes.content:
Updated to "SteamVR 2.0" - supporting input mapping for all input types.

Sorry to everyone experiencing the game-breaking laser pointer issues, it should be resolved.

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Lowered volume of objective progress sound
[*] Added objective progress indicator for Store 1 objective 4
[*] Restored music to all levels to what they are in the mobile game
[*] Added delete progress button to the main hub
[*] No longer use indicators for controls in tutorial as they may be changed
[*] Updated unity version*
[/list]

*this may fix issues some have had getting objective 2 in Office 3, I have had no control over the consistency of awarding the star.
